canonicalization: Candidates are expanded to an equivalent P1 CIF for backend robustness; the periodic structure is unchanged.
fitted_identically_per_candidate: Gaussian Caglioti U and W with V fixed at zero
interpretation: A comparable profile-fit ranking, not proof of structural identity; wrong cells, orderings, or coordinate models can retain low Rwp.
other_profile_terms: V, X, Y, polarization, and axial-asymmetry terms use the same neutral fixed baseline for every candidate.
weighting: uniform point weights because the supplied CSV has no uncertainties
